title: decamelize splits an all-caps word that ends with a number
description: A capitalised word that ends in a number is split in two: `decamelize('CAPLOCKED1')` should return `caplocked1`, because an all-uppercase run followed by digits is one word. Fix it without changing how an acronym followed by a capitalised word is handled (`URLString` is still `url_string`). Upstream issue: sindresorhus/decamelize#21.
acceptance_criteria: acronym handling such as `URLString` to `url_string` and `testGUILabel` to `test_gui_label` is unchanged
notes: SWE-bench-style. base_ref is the upstream fix's parent; hidden/test.js is the upstream test file at fix_commit. The scratch repo must hold base_ref's history only (bench/factory/README.md, 'Scratch repositories').
